WITH RepCounts AS (
  SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
  FROM Employee e
  JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City
), RepAverages AS (
  SELECT City, AVG(CustomerCount) AS CityAvgCustomers
  FROM RepCounts
  GROUP BY City
), AboveAverageReps AS (
  SELECT r.EmployeeId, r.City, r.CustomerCount, a.CityAvgCustomers
  FROM RepCounts r
  JOIN RepAverages a ON r.City = a.City
  WHERE r.CustomerCount > a.CityAvgCustomers
), OverallCustomerTotal AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerTotal
  FROM Customer
)
SELECT r.City,
       SUM(r.CustomerCount) AS TotalCustomers,
       AVG(r.CustomerCount - r.CityAvgCustomers) AS AvgAboveCityAverage,
       AVG(1.0 * r.CustomerCount / t.CustomerTotal) AS AvgRepShareOfOverallCustomers
FROM AboveAverageReps r
CROSS JOIN OverallCustomerTotal t
GROUP BY r.City;
